title: Sequoia · CT abdomen — the paperwork-only payer

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Omar, tell me about this abdominal pain you called about.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: It sits low on my right side and comes in waves, mostly after meals. Two weeks now.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Any fevers, unexplained weight loss, or blood where there should not be any?

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: No, none of that. Appetite is normal too.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: Good. Your labs from Tuesday are unremarkable, which is reassuring but does not explain the pain.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: So what is next? I am on Sequoia Mutual if that matters for approvals.

utterances.speaker: doctor
utterances.text: It matters for the paperwork, not the medicine. Given two weeks of localized pain with clean labs, we should get a CT scan of the abdomen and pelvis.

utterances.speaker: patient
utterances.text: Okay. I would rather know than keep guessing.
